newsitem.title: USA: Mesaba February load factor off.
newsitem.headline: Mesaba February load factor off.

text.p: Mesaba Airlines, operating as Northwest Airlink, said Thursday its February pasenger load factor declined 1.2 points to 48.0 percent from 49.2 percent a year ago.

The airline, a unit of Mesaba Holdings Inc, said February available seat miles rose 22.5 percent to 73.4 million from 59.9 million, and revenue passenger miles rose 19.6 percent to 35.2 million from 29.5 million.

Year to date, the carrier said its load factor dipped 0.4 points to 46.3 percent from 46.7 percent. Available seat miles increased 18.9 percent to 145.4 million from 122.3 million, and revenue passenger miles increased 17.9 percent to 67.3 million from 57.1 million.
